text: Valermo Drive is an east-west collector road, that runs east off Browns Line and ends at the entrance to Connorvale Park in the Alderwood neighbourhood of Ward 6. The street intersects with thirteen other residential streets along its length, and has a speed limit of 50km/hr. Valermo Drive is populated with single family homes, and a former school which is currently being redeveloped with residential dwellings. Due to its length and central location between Browns Line, Horner Avenue, and Evans Avenue, and Connorvale Park, Valermo Drive is used as a high-speed cut through. I am requesting a traffic study to identify any potential traffic calming measures along the street.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke York District, to undertake a study of traffic calming measures on Valermo Drive, and report to the Etobicoke York Community Council.
